## Root Cause Analysis

**Issue:** Port mismatch between Service and Pod configurations.

| Resource | Port Configuration |
|----------|-------------------|
| Service `app` targetPort | **8080** ❌ |
| Pod containerPort | **80** ✅ (nginx default) |

The Service was forwarding traffic to port 8080 on each Pod, but the nginx application only listens on port 80. This caused all requests through the Service to fail while Pods remained healthy and endpoints appeared ready.

Updated the Service `app` in namespace `default`:
```
kubectl patch svc app -n default \
  -p '{"spec":{"ports":[{"name":"http","port":80,"protocol":"TCP","targetPort":80}]}}'

This changed `targetPort` from **8080** to **80**, matching the Pod's containerPort.

|----------|-------------------|
| Service `app` targetPort | **8080** ❌ |
